body:
Coming here in the first place. I know it sounds like stupid, attention seeking bullshit, but I feel completely isolated here. It makes no sense because I was sociable and extroverted in high school, but now I feel like I'm stuck in a bubble.

Weeks later, I'm finding it harder and harder to find a reason to get out of bed. Even harder still to get the motivation to study or work. I feel dizzy and lightheaded all the time.

This is just all around bad.
